author: mycolorisgreen
body:
Hi guys! This is my new account, well, backup account, and I'm appealing a ban for my main account: Deadly_Wolf19. My friend got onto my account and put on xray, and fly mod (or hack) and I tried it out for a few days. I got caught. I didn't know it was a ban, I thought it would just be a kick, but I got banned. I believe I should be unbanned because i've done my time and learned my lesson. That was my first time ever being banned. That occurred almost 2 years ago. I no longer have hacks, nor want hacks.
Please, I love this server.
Thanks,
-MyColorIsGreen
